name: a weight range over a match with weight breaks takes the breaks and their neighbours
a money range steps by its written cents
source:
tariff "t"
input rate: Money/mi = $0.55/mi
charge "x" = rate * shipment.distance
property "p" {
  vary input.rate in $0.50/mi..$0.60/mi
  expect total >= $0
}

name: a weight range steps by its written tenths
dates step by a day and date-times by a minute
source:
tariff "t"
charge "x" = $1
property "p" {
  vary d in @2026-01-01..@2026-01-06
  vary t in @2026-01-01T00:00Z..=@2026-01-01T00:03Z
  expect d.year == 2026 and t.hour == 0
}

name: a rate table's band edges are landmarks
source:
tariff "t"
let rate = tables.Breaks[shipment.weight ?? 0 lb] ?? $0/cwt
charge "x" = rate * (shipment.weight ?? 0 lb)
property "p" {
  vary shipment.weight in 100 lb..=1_000 lb
  expect total >= $0
}

name: an input varies over its constraint at the constraint's written precision
source:
tariff "t"
input rate: Money/mi = $0.52/mi where $0.50/mi..=$0.55/mi
charge "x" = rate * shipment.distance
property "p" {
  vary input.rate
  expect total >= $0
}

name: enums take every variant and an optional one also none
source:
tariff "t"
charge "x" = $1
property "p" {
  vary rating.mode
  vary shipment.freightClass
  vary shipment.hazmat
  expect total == $1
}
